You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.
If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of…
I have given them your word. The world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

translations.bsb: You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
